public.text: Regional governance is given a financial-sustainability mandate, but no options are provided for allocating costs across countries with different population sizes, income levels, usage, and ability to pay.
public.suggestedRevision: Add cost-sharing models based on equal contribution, population, usage, income, benefit, or blended formulas, with solidarity mechanisms and protection against excluding lower-resource participants.
